thread:
Priya K.: FYI BlueHorizon (acct 1204) invoices for Mar 2026 look off. Several usage line items are missing (GPU preemptible hours) and total is ~$4,752 short. Noticed when CS compared usage portal vs invoice.

billing-bot: invoice-generator job 2026-04-05T08:14:10Z completed with 2 WARN, 0 ERROR. WARN: 1 invoice(s) generated with truncated usage windows. job id job_20260405_0814

Dan L.: Which invoice id?

Priya K.: INV-2026-03-04567 (pdf: https://payments.internal.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-03-04567.pdf). Raw json: s3://billing-outputs/2026/03/INV-2026-03-04567.json

Ravi M.: Pulling raw now. Quick glance: usage partitioned by day, but the ETL bucketing uses UTC cutover and their account is in America/Los_Angeles with billing_profile.local_billing_window enabled. Some preemptible job runs at 23:30 PT (06:30 UTC next day) appear assigned to next day's bucket and then dropped by downstream dedupe that expects local bucket keys.

Ravi M.: Suspect predicate in transform:
```sql
SELECT * FROM daily_usage du
WHERE du.bucket_date = DATE_TRUNC('day', du.event_ts) -- this uses server timezone (UTC) not customer local_window
```

Clara (Acct): Also spotted an odd duplicate invoice record for BlueHorizon: INV-2026-03-04567 and INV-2026-03-04567-01 both in Draft. Payment not captured. Please hold autopay.

Priya K.: Put holds on both. billing-bot, please apply invoice_hold.

billing-bot: action logged: invoice_hold applied on INV-2026-03-04567 by Priya K. at 2026-04-05T08:32:04Z

Dan L.: Plan: (1) patch ETL to use coalesce(tenant_tz, 'UTC') for bucket calculation and include explicit local_window offset, (2) re-run usage aggregation for acct 1204 only, (3) regenerate invoice, (4) void duplicate draft.

Dan L.: Patch ready in PR https://git.internal.redwood/usage-etl/pulls/198 — adds tz-aware truncation and unit tests for DST edge cases. Requesting deploy to staging.

Ravi M.: To reprocess just that account run:
```bash
usage-aggregate --account 1204 --start 2026-03-01 --end 2026-03-31 --tz America/Los_Angeles --mode fix
billing-reprocess --account 1204 --period 2026-03 --mode regenerate --reason "tz bucket truncation"
```

Clara (Acct): While this is being sorted, please create a provisional credit for the missing amount so CS can reassure the customer: $4,752.00. Link to both draft invoices and mark as provisional.

Priya K.: Created provisional credit memo PC-2026-04-0019 $4,752.00 and linked to INV-2026-03-04567 and INV-2026-03-04567-01. Note added to account.

billing-bot: finance-ops ticket created: FIN-4927 "BlueHorizon missing preemptible usage lines + duplicate draft invoices" assigned to Billing Ops.

Dan L.: Deployed ETL fix to staging, running full day re-agg now. Will push to prod after smoke tests (est ~40 mins).

Ravi M.: Prod deploy done at 2026-04-05T09:15:00Z. Re-agg and reprocess completed at 2026-04-05T09:52:13Z. job id job_reproc_1204_202603. Regenerated invoice uploaded s3://billing-outputs/2026/03/INV-2026-03-04567-corrected.pdf. Original duplicate draft voided.

Clara (Acct): Verified corrected invoice, provisional credit converted to official credit memo CM-2026-04-0020 for $4,752.00 and applied. Reached out to BlueHorizon with explanation and offered fee reimbursement for their payment processor if they were charged.

Priya K.: Thanks everyone. Closing FIN-4927 after postmortem items: add tz-aware aggregation tests, enforce duplicate-detecter on draft generation, and add monitoring metric for "invoice amount delta vs usage portal" > $1000. :thumbsup:
